visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a well-lit indoor dining setting with white curtains in the background. A man in a dark suit and a woman in a beige sweater are seated at a table with dishes and glasses. The man uses chopsticks to point at the food while looking at the woman with an insistent expression. He then picks up a whole cooked fish and holds it up to the woman's face. The woman looks hesitant, then opens her mouth wide as if to eat it. (2) The scene shifts to the same two individuals at a different table. The man is now wearing a blue sweatshirt. He gestures actively with his hands and places food into the woman's bowl using chopsticks. The woman is seen eating while the man continues his animated persuasion. (3) The background changes to a solid bright red. The man is wearing a formal black tuxedo and the woman is in a white wedding dress, both holding wine glasses. The man aggressively feeds the woman with chopsticks multiple times in rapid succession. Several other hands holding chopsticks appear from the edges of the frame to feed the woman simultaneously. (4) The final phase shows the man in a bright yellow sweatshirt and the woman in a white t-shirt at a dining table. The man holds up a fish again, and the woman reacts with a surprised, open-mouthed expression before he feeds her.

The humor is derived from the escalating pressure and the repetition of the same situation in varied settings.
